scenarios.given_and_action: Import the fixed 1,909 Git blobs at project version 0.
scenarios.expected_success: One complete baseline; exact raw hashes, original IDs, relations, paths and lifecycle history; project 0 to 1.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Duplicate ID, unresolved relation, missing/extra manifest entry or unsupported worktree export: 422 HAG_REMOTE_INVALID_IMPORT.
Changed bytes for a declared source identity: 409 HAG_REMOTE_SOURCE_MISMATCH; no graph, guard or receipt changes.

scenarios.given_and_action: Repeat the same import, first with the original key and then a new key.
scenarios.expected_success: Same key returns exactly the original receipt without increment. New key creates one new operation and guard increment, reusing baseline and revisions.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Reused key with changed content: 409 HAG_REMOTE_KEY_REUSE.
Raw LF/CRLF, Unicode, body and edge edits produce distinct identities per fixed byte vectors; original B remains unchanged.

scenarios.given_and_action: Read WO-RLS-038 at the imported B through the packaged client.
scenarios.expected_success: Exactly 12 governing IDs and 11 declared paths; dependencies and relevant decisions are separate; unchanged released oracle output accompanies the result.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: A synthetic open blocking decision remains an evaluator finding, never an approval.
Missing historical evidence reports unavailable bindings and cannot become a successful governing assessment; preserve original fixture.

scenarios.given_and_action: Use all six domain reads through HTTP and MCP on identical explicit views.
scenarios.expected_success: Same selection, revisions, provenance and meaningful findings; compare shows only proposed differences; B remains unchanged.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Unknown accessible identity: 404; cross-project access: 403 before disclosure.
Stale context version: 409 HAG_REMOTE_STALE_CONTEXT.
Budget stop: complete=false with same-view continuation; no empty complete success. Missing references are explicit and prevent completeness.

scenarios.given_and_action: Open a context at B; create an incomplete requirement template; revise body and derives_from to a valid capability.
scenarios.expected_success: Open: project +1, context 0. Create/revise: project and context +1 each, new immutable revisions and declared edges. Draft findings remain; no approval event.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Freeze with unresolved targets: 422 HAG_REMOTE_INCOMPLETE_SELECTION.
A complete resolved draft selection can freeze without claiming approval; freeze increments project only and preserves the open context/base.

scenarios.given_and_action: Submit an invalid/protected draft or locally valid request with different server rights/identity.
scenarios.expected_success: Server independently evaluates the exact selected input using the qualified released evaluator.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Malformed TOML, duplicate metadata, ID/type mismatch, requirement derives_from release record: 422 HAG_REMOTE_INVALID_DRAFT.
Protected identity/type/lifecycle/provenance/evidence edit: 422 HAG_REMOTE_PROTECTED_FIELD.
Forged actor field: 400 HAG_REMOTE_MALFORMED; lifecycle operation: 400 HAG_REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.
Reader write: 403; unsupported evaluator/client tuple: 409. Every refusal leaves revisions, edges, heads, guards and receipts unchanged.

scenarios.given_and_action: Race two independent database connections with different keys at the same project version N.
scenarios.expected_success: Exactly one commit moves N to N+1; losing command returns 409 HAG_REMOTE_STALE_PROJECT with no effects.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Changing only a governing dependency still invalidates a pending request.
Old context or selected revision: specific stale-context/stale-revision conflict after project guard check.
No automatic update of expected versions or rebase.

scenarios.given_and_action: Suppress a committed response, then lookup/retry; race identical keys; inject precommit and commit failures.
scenarios.expected_success: Authenticated same-principal/project equal retry returns the exact original result before version checks; concurrent equal keys produce one accepted receipt.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Changed semantic request under key: 409 HAG_REMOTE_KEY_REUSE; unknown key: 404 HAG_REMOTE_OPERATION_UNKNOWN, not proof of rollback.
Before-commit rollback leaves no graph, guard or receipt effects. An uncertain commit remains unknown until lookup or identical retry resolves it.
Expired credentials and revoked project access refuse even an accepted retry.

scenarios.given_and_action: Run the narrow parameterized MATCH/WHERE/RETURN/LIMIT grammar at B and an explicit context.
scenarios.expected_success: Server binds the view, applies aggregate row/byte/depth/time limits and rolls back the exploratory transaction; HTTP/MCP use the same handler.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Write, CALL, subquery, admin/schema, loader, multiple statement or ambiguous grammar: 400 HAG_REMOTE_QUERY_SYNTAX before execution.
Exercise case, comments, literals and parameter substitution with AST admission; never keyword matching.
Budget stop reports incomplete, or 429 when no bounded honest result fits. Database-side read-only enforcement remains open.

scenarios.given_and_action: Run every one of the 12 HAG-OPS-004 steps through actual packaged CLI/plugin guidance, HTTP/MCP/Cypher and database.
scenarios.expected_success: All 12 step observations retained with exact component tuple, B preservation, draft changes, refusal, retry and read-only released check.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: A skipped step, mock substitution, missing package identity or failed step leaves the walkthrough unperformed/failed, never passed.

scenarios.given_and_action: Assess historic records through canonical original-path projections and the pinned immutable code/evidence resolver.
scenarios.expected_success: Original scoped-code and path/content hashes reproduce independently under released canonical text handling; raw remote hashes stay separate.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Move a file, change scoped code or remove evidence: retain the corresponding released findings/unavailability.
Remote baseline hash cannot satisfy legacy fields; same-version substituted wheel, wrong payload, candidate fallback or unsupported release refuses.

scenarios.given_and_action: Qualify actual packages/images, explicit schema initialization, restart on retained volume and backup restore to a fresh volume.
scenarios.expected_success: Report actual tuple, schema, B and receipt equality at recorded backup cutoff, limits, latency, storage and restore time.
expected_failures_and_boundaries: Uninitialized/incompatible schema or unsupported tuple fails readiness/mutation before effects; no automatic migration.
Missing build/install/recovery observations remain unperformed. No production SLA or release/publication claim.
